editionData.title: ‘Ball in US court’ with deal on the table, says Iran; Hebron governor says Israeli forces withdraw from city after 10-day siege
editionData.description: Global headlines: ‘Ball in US court’ with deal on the table, says Iran (Tehran says it passed a proposal through Qatari mediators to the US and it's now up to Washington to decide); Hebron governor says Israeli forces withdraw from city after 10-day siege (Hebron Mayor Youssef al-Jaabari says families forced from their homes can return and students can go to school); and Bangladesh garment factories disrupted as protests continue for third day (Workers in Bangladesh's largest export sector are demanding a minimum wage increase amid rising inflation). Markets leaned lower, with 4 of 7 tracked indexes down; NASDAQ Composite down 2.86% was the largest move. Benchmarks tracked: S&P 500, NASDAQ Composite, Euronext 100 Index, and Public Joint-Stock Company Moscow Exchange MICEX-RTS plus 3 more indexes. Hacker News: Show HN: Wikihack – HackerTube, but for Wikipedia articles mentioned on HN (The Wikipedia articles Hacker News keeps linking to, ranked by how many different commenters linked them); Show HN: HackerBooks – HackerTube, but for books mentioned on HN (A bookshelf of the books Hacker News readers mention most, 2007–2026); and HackerTube: YouTube built from videos recommended by HN (Instead of YouTube, watch HackerTube). headlines.summary: Election body says deadlocked result won't be undermined even if foreign interference claims are found to be true.

headlines.title: UN's peacekeeping mission in disputed Western Sahara ends after 35 years
headlines.summary: The U.N.'s long-running peacekeeping mission for the disputed Western Sahara ceased operations Sunday after 35 years. Once ruled by Spain, it is claimed by both Morocco and the pro-independence Polisario Front.

headlines.title: 9 dead as jet nosedives and erupts into fireball near busy roadway in South Florida
headlines.summary: U.S. Transportation Secretary Duffy says all nine people died aboard a business jet that crashed into a Florida neighborhood. The aircraft departed from Austin, Texas, and was headed to the Bahamas.

headlines.title: Do you know signs of a stroke? BE FAST are the words to remember
headlines.summary: Sen. Chris Murphy is expected to fully recover from his stroke. The acronym BE FAST can help you remember the symptoms of stroke and what to do when it happens: Call 911 quickly.

headlines.title: Gulf region on edge as Qatar leads talks with Iran to stave off new U.S. attacks
headlines.summary: Qatar has been leading intense mediation efforts over the past 72 hours to prevent a new round of possible U.S. attacks on Iran after Tuesday's midterm elections. The uncertainty has the entire Gulf region on edge.

headlines.title: Haley Stevens endorses GOP candidate in Michigan Senate race, spurning Abdul El-Sayed
headlines.summary: Rep. Haley Stevens was scheduled to attend a unity event today with Abdul El-Sayed, who beat her in the Democratic primary. Instead, she endorsed his Republican opponent, Mike Rogers.

headlines.title: Private jet crashes in Florida, all nine on board killed
headlines.summary: A private jet crashed in a residential area in Florida on Sunday afternoon, killing all nine people on board and scattering burning debris across a wide area.

headlines.title: Chinese audiovisual exhibitors take center stage at African event
headlines.summary: CAPE TOWN — The China Pavilion took center stage on Wednesday at MIP Africa 2026, a major film and television industry event in Africa, showcasing a diverse range of Chinese audiovisual content and promoting cultural exchange and industry cooperation between China and the continent.

headlines.title: Iran pushes 7-day peace plan
headlines.summary: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said Iran remained in close contact with intermediaries about its seven-day plan, which would involve reopening the Strait of Hormuz, while the United States is reportedly mulling fresh strikes against Iran after US midterm elections.

headlines.title: ECB leaves interest rates unchanged
headlines.summary: FRANKFURT -- The European Central Bank (ECB) announced on Thursday that it would leave its key interest rates unchanged.

headlines.title: Experts hail CPC's focus on self-governance
headlines.summary: China's model of self-governance, as highlighted in the latest plenary session of the 20th Communist Party of China Central Committee, offers valuable lessons for ruling parties across the world, experts said.

headlines.summary: Six Indian tourists stranded by heavy snowfall in Nepal’s Shey-Phoksundo area were rescued and are receiving hospital care; condition is stable.
